headline: Business Development & Strategic Growth Specialist | B2B Sales & Client Relations
summary: Results-oriented Business Development professional with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in strategic growth, client relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration. Proven track record in driving sustainable business growth through data-driven strategies, market intelligence analysis, and high-stakes negotiations. Expert in building decision networks and fostering customer intimacy within complex B2B ecosystems, including financial services and technology sectors. Adept at aligning technical solutions with business goals, managing CRM pipelines, and ensuring compliance with ethical standards. Seeking to leverage strong analytical skills and relationship-building expertise to drive market expansion and strategic partnerships at Alstom.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Defined and implemented strategic growth plans for major financial platforms, driving year-over-year sustainable growth through data-driven campaign management across MENA, EU, and Asian markets.
Strengthened customer intimacy by presenting tailored solutions that enhanced operational KPIs, managing full-funnel metrics including ROAS, conversion optimization, and lead generation.
Collaborated closely with engineering and technical teams to align customer needs with risk mitigation and profitability goals, ensuring seamless delivery of complex digital products.
Compiled market intelligence on trends and competitor positioning to inform strategic actions, utilizing CRM tools to provide timely updates on opportunities and pipeline status.
Ensured strict compliance with industry regulations and ethical standards in all business development and marketing activities.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed relationships with key decision-makers and influencers (KOLs) to influence decision-making processes and expand market reach in the Web3 ecosystem.
Supported strategic growth initiatives by coordinating cross-functional campaigns, ensuring alignment with regional business plans and brand positioning.
Managed end-to-end client onboarding and relationship management, focusing on retention and long-term partnership development.
Analyzed customer feedback and market trends to refine product messaging and improve customer operation KPIs.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Tech Sales & Business Development Manager role at Alstom. With a background in strategic growth, B2B client relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration, I bring a proven ability to drive sustainable business growth and strengthen customer intimacy. My experience in defining business development strategies, compiling market intelligence, and managing complex stakeholder networks aligns perfectly with Alstom's mission to deliver smarter mobility solutions. I am excited about the opportunity to apply my expertise in negotiation, strategic planning, and compliance-driven business development to support your team in Cairo.

screening.q: Do you have a graduate degree in Engineering or Business?
screening.a: Yes, I hold a Bachelor of Business Administration.

screening.q: Do you have at least 10 years of experience in the rail or related business, or project engineering industries?
screening.a: No. My experience is in Growth Marketing, Business Development, and Tech Sales within the Financial and Crypto sectors. However, I possess strong transferable skills in strategic planning, B2B relationship building, and cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams.

screening.q: Do you have good knowledge and connections with transport clients/customers in the country/cluster/region?
screening.a: No, my client base is focused on financial markets and technology. However, I have extensive experience building and managing high-value B2B relationships and decision networks in complex industries.

screening.q: Are you proficient in understanding organizational products and services?
screening.a: Yes, I have experience in quickly mastering complex technical and financial products to present tailored solutions to clients, supported by my technical background and ability to collaborate with engineering teams.
